sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipe1 ColorConv red coefficient register 1 (DCMIPP_P1CCRR1)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.58 "DCMIPP Pipe1 ColorConv red coefficient register 1 (DCMIPP_P1CCRR1)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1944.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x884
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Coefficients of the ColorConv, in signed 2.8 format (1.0 is coded by 0x100). The sign is
indicated as complement to 2.
Bits 31:27 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 26:16 RG[10:0]: Coefficient row 1 column 2 of the matrix
Bits 15:11 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 10:0 RR[10:0]: Coefficient row 1 column 1 of the matrix
